title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Ecological Protection and High-quality Development of the Yellow River Basin
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yellow River Basin

Fa Fa [2020] No. 19

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, fully leverage the adjudicative functions of the people's courts, and provide fair and efficient judicial services and guarantees for the national strategy of ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin, the following opinion is formulated.

I. Effectively Raise Ideological Understanding and Enhance the Responsibility of Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yellow River Basin

1. Deeply understand the momentous significance of the national strategy for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. The Yellow River is the mother river of the Chinese nation. The Yellow River Basin is an ecological corridor connecting the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, the Loess Plateau, and the North China Plain. It is an important economic zone and a core cultural protection and inheritance area in China, as well as a region where multiple ethnic groups live together and a key area for winning the battle against poverty. The ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin have great practical significance and far-reaching historical impact for promoting the economic and social development and ecological security of the areas along the Yellow River and for realizing the great rejuvenation and sustainable development of the Chinese nation. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the sacred duties and important missions they shoulder, and effectively enhance the consciousness and initiative in providing judicial services and guarantees for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.

2. Accurately grasp the strategic positioning and basic principles of the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. People's courts at all levels must firmly establish the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, unswervingly follow the path of prioritizing ecological protection and promoting green development, and comprehensively promote high-level ecological environment protection and high-quality economic development in the Yellow River Basin. Thoroughly implement the concept of adapting measures to local conditions and implementing policies by category, based on the entire basin, coordinate planning for upstream and downstream areas, main streams and tributaries, and left and right banks, determine development by water resources and act in accordance with water carrying capacity, jointly focus on major protection, and coordinately promote major governance. Fully implement the concept of prioritizing prevention and focusing on restoration, follow the comprehensive governance of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands, and deserts, coordinate the application of criminal, civil, and administrative legal responsibilities, promote the protection and restoration of the basin's ecological environment and the rational development and utilization of natural resources, and strive to make the Yellow River a river of benefit to the people.

3. Continuously improve the level of judicial services and guarantees for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. People's courts at all levels must adjudicate various types of cases fairly, efficiently, and in accordance with the law, fully leverage the deterrence and educational functions of criminal trials, the prevention and supervision functions of administrative trials, the relief and compensation functions of civil trials, and the evaluation and guidance functions of public interest litigation judgments, focus on strengthening ecological protection and governance, ensuring the long-term stability and safety of the Yellow River, promoting the conservation and intensive use of water resources, promoting high-quality development of the entire basin, protecting, inheriting, and promoting Yellow River culture. Actively explore the construction of a basin judicial mechanism, optimize the allocation of trial resources, strengthen work coordination and linkage, promote diversified dispute resolution, advance the modernization of the basin's trial system and trial capacity, and comprehensively improve the quality and efficiency of services and guarantees for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.

II. Fully Leverage Adjudicative Functions to Provide Fair and Efficient Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yellow River Basin

4. Implement strict liability and strengthen the overall protection of the Yellow River ecosystem. Adhere to the strictest rule of law concept, punish in accordance with the law criminal acts such as environmental pollution, illegal mining and destructive exploitation, illegal logging of trees, illegal fishing of aquatic products, illegal hunting and killing of precious and endangered wild animals, severely punish crimes of dereliction of duty in environmental supervision and crimes of major safety accidents causing serious environmental pollution consequences, and build a solid ecological barrier for the Yellow River Basin. Strengthen the trial of cases concerning the failure of administrative organs to perform their duties of investigating and handling environmental violations, supervise and support administrative organs in implementing basin supervision responsibilities in accordance with the law. Adhere to the principle of polluter pays and full compensation, pursue in accordance with the law the civil liability of those who pollute the environment and damage the ecology, encourage and support the aggregation of production factors towards ecological and environmental protection directions such as sand prevention and control, and promote the construction of a comprehensive geological disaster prevention and control system. Properly adjudicate cases of environmental public interest litigation and ecological and environmental damage compensation, enhance the water conservation capacity of the upper reaches of the Yellow River, promote soil and water conservation and pollution prevention in the middle reaches, strengthen the protection of the wetland ecosystem in the lower reaches, and improve biodiversity.

5. Promote water and sediment regulation and maintain the long-term stability and safety of the Yellow River. Make the adjudication of cases involving water and sediment relationship regulation a key focus of basin trial work, and effectively ensure the long-term peace and safety of the Yellow River. Support in accordance with the law the relevant departments in managing the water source areas and conservation wetlands in the upper reaches of the Yellow River, implement ecological migration and relocation, returning farmland to forests and grasslands, rodent and pest control, and other grassland ecological environment governance measures, and restore river channels and wetland functions. Standardize river channel administrative licensing matters, and maintain river channel management order. Ensure the operation of the water and sediment regulation mechanism, strictly implement the responsibility system for river chiefs and lake chiefs, control the over-exploitation of groundwater, and slow down the siltation of the lower reaches of the Yellow River. Severely crack down on illegal acts such as illegal water extraction and illegal sand mining, and do a good job in flood control and disaster reduction projects, comprehensive soil erosion control, to ensure the safety of life and property of the people along the Yellow River.

6. Promote green water use and advance the conservation and intensive use of water resources. Ensure in accordance with the law the strict implementation of the water allocation plan for the Yellow River Basin, control the total amount of water extraction, and resolutely curb unreasonable water demand. Comprehensively strengthen the supervision of administrative acts such as water extraction, water use, water function zone management, and water and sediment regulation administrative licensing and rights confirmation in the Yellow River Basin, support administrative organs in supervising in accordance with the law, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts. Properly adjudicate cases involving water-saving industries, water-saving technologies, and water-saving facilities, promote the transformation of water use patterns from extensive to conservation and intensive, ensure the rational planning of population, cities, and industrial development, and ensure the stability of agricultural production. Implement the water function zone management system to ensure the continuous improvement of water resources conditions. Support in accordance with the law the construction of water conservancy projects in pastoral areas, small hydropower replacing fuel, and check dams on the Loess Plateau, and consolidate the achievements of returning farmland to forests.

7. Support innovation-driven development and promote high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. Fully implement the new development concept, properly adjudicate cases involving new technologies, new business forms, and new models, and effectively serve the transformation and upgrading of the industrial structure in areas along the Yellow River. Protect property rights equally in accordance with the law, stimulate and protect innovation, guide various market entities to engage in orderly and benign competition, and create a law-based business environment within the basin. Strengthen the trial of bankruptcy reorganization cases, and improve the system and mechanism for the exit of market entities. Assist in the construction of beautiful villages, support the provinces and autonomous regions in the basin in winning the battle against poverty, and ensure the smooth implementation of the rural revitalization strategy. Leverage the adjudicative functions of foreign-related civil and commercial trials, promote the organic connection between the high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin and the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative, and serve a new pattern of higher-level opening up.

8. Protect cultural resources, inherit and promote Yellow River culture. Severely crack down on criminal acts such as damaging cultural relics, damaging places of historic interest and scenic beauty, illegally excavating ancient cultural sites and ancient tombs, and illegally excavating ancient human fossils and ancient vertebrate fossils, severely punish criminals who destroy cultural and natural relics in the Yellow River Basin, and protect the historical and cultural heritage of the Yellow River. Strengthen judicial protection for literary and artistic works and intangible cultural heritage related to the Yellow River Basin, and promote the historical inheritance and innovative development of Yellow River culture. Leverage the special role of public interest litigation, effectively release the potential and vitality of social organizations in protecting Yellow River culture, support procuratorial organs in filing civil and administrative public interest lawsuits, coordinate cultural inheritance and utilization with ecological protection and governance, realize the promotion and continuation of the value of Yellow River culture, and solidify the root and soul of the Chinese nation.

9. Strengthen restoration measures and ensure the governance of the Yellow River ecological environment. Adhere to the judicial concept of prioritizing protection and focusing on restoration, guard the ecological conservation redline, and promote the restoration of the ecological environment and the rational development and utilization of natural resources. Innovate trial and execution methods, fully leverage the role of injunctions for environmental protection, based on the restoration requirements of different environmental elements, explore diversified ecological restoration methods, and improve the environmental restoration responsibility system that organically integrates criminal sanctions, civil compensation, and ecological compensation. Establish and improve the management, use, audit supervision, and accountability systems for special funds for public interest litigation and ecological and environmental damage compensation litigation to ensure timely and effective restoration of the ecological environment. Promote the diversification of restoration entities, strengthen coordination with administrative organs in environmental damage identification, restoration method selection, and supervision of judgment execution, broaden channels for third-party alternative performance and public participation in ecological and environmental protection and restoration, and form a basin ecological environment governance pattern of joint contribution, shared governance, and shared benefits.

10. Focus on implementing policies by category and adapt judicial functions to local conditions. Fully consider the differences between the upper, middle, and lower reaches of the Yellow River, combine local realities and regional characteristics, properly adjudicate relevant cases based on different judicial needs, and coordinate the high-quality economic development and high-level ecological protection of the Yellow River Basin. Focus on strengthening judicial guarantees for the governance of the ecological environment in areas such as the Sanjiangyuan (Three-River Source) region, the Qilian Mountains, the Gannan Yellow River upstream water conservation area, the Loess Plateau, and the estuarine delta wetlands, and create good ecological products. Focus on strengthening judicial guarantees for the rational development and utilization of energy resources in areas such as the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain, the Hetao Irrigation District, and the Fen-Wei Plain, ensure national food security, and increase economic carrying capacity. Focus on strengthening judicial guarantees for flood control safety, drinking water safety, and ecological safety in the upper and middle reaches and the downstream floodplain areas, improve infrastructure and public service levels, and continuously improve people's livelihoods.

III. Build a Basin Judicial Mechanism to Form a Joint Force for Promoting the Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yellow River Basin

11. Improve specialized adjudicative institutions. Implement the "Guiding Opinions on Building a Modern Environmental Governance System" issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, promote the construction of specialized adjudicative institutions for environmental resources in the Yellow River Basin, and unify the scope of case acceptance and trial procedures for environmental resource cases. Strengthen the construction of intellectual property courts to guarantee the inheritance of Yellow River culture and serve innovation-driven development. Fully leverage the role of international commercial courts to serve the joint construction of the Belt and Road Initiative and assist in building a new system of a higher-level open economy. Coordinate the overall protection needs of the ecological environment and cultural resources of the Yellow River Basin, and deepen the reform of the "three-in-one" centralized adjudication mechanism for intellectual property and environmental resource criminal, civil, and administrative cases.

12. Improve centralized jurisdiction over cases. Summarize the practical experience of centralized jurisdiction across administrative regions for intellectual property, foreign-related, administrative, and environmental resource trials, adhere to reform and innovation, and build a case centralized jurisdiction mechanism that meets the needs of the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. Strengthen the collaborative trial mechanism between courts with centralized jurisdiction within the basin and between courts with centralized jurisdiction and those without centralized jurisdiction. Explore the establishment of a cross-provincial centralized jurisdiction mechanism for ecological protection cases in ecological functional areas such as basins and wetlands, and in natural protected areas such as national parks.

13. Expand basin judicial cooperation. Establish a normal judicial cooperation mechanism for the Yellow River Basin, and strengthen work coordination and docking between local courts within the basin in case filing, trial, and execution. Promote the reform of cross-regional case filing and litigation services, and promote remote handling of litigation matters across regions and coordinated handling across levels between local courts within the basin. For major, difficult, and complex issues of legal application within the basin, relevant courts shall jointly discuss, research, and resolve them. Improve the integrated execution command system within the basin, and promote judicial cooperation between courts in different locations within the basin in matters such as inquiries, freezes, seizures, investigations, or service of legal documents. Based on the needs of ecological environment governance within the basin, establish a judicial cooperation mechanism for environmental resources among the people's courts of the nine provinces and autonomous regions along the Yellow River.

14. Promote departmental coordination and linkage. Actively integrate into the social governance system of the Yellow River Basin, which is led by Party committees, responsible by governments, with democratic consultation, social coordination, public participation, legal guarantees, and technological support. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with procuratorial organs, public security organs, and administrative law enforcement organs in accordance with the law, and achieve orderly connection in evidence collection and preservation, case coordination and resolution, and supervision and execution of judgments. Regarding issues found during trial and execution, communicate promptly with relevant departments, propose judicial suggestions, and promote the formation of a joint force for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.

15. Promote diversified dispute resolution. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, strengthen source governance of litigation, deepen the reform of the "separation, adjustment, adjudication, and review" mechanism, accelerate the construction of a "one-stop" diversified dispute resolution mechanism, and efficiently serve the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. Promote and improve the joint working mechanism of people's mediation, administrative mediation, and judicial mediation, do a good job in the organic connection between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms such as conciliation, mediation, arbitration, notarization, administrative adjudication, and administrative reconsideration, and provide judicial confirmation in accordance with the law for mediation agreements and ecological and environmental damage compensation agreements reached through consultation. Actively rely on local Party committees and governments, coordinate all social forces, and resolve various types of mass disputes in a timely manner in accordance with the law.

16. Smooth information sharing channels. Comprehensively strengthen the construction of smart courts, strengthen interconnection between local courts in the upper, middle, and lower reaches, left and right banks, and main streams and tributaries of the Yellow River Basin, promote the establishment of cloud computing and big data application platforms, use blockchain technology, and realize information resource sharing among local courts within the basin, maximizing trial quality and efficiency. Fully apply the China Mobile Micro Court, adhere to the combination of online and offline, and smooth the three-dimensional litigation service channels within the Yellow River Basin. Deepen the information construction in execution management, network investigation and control, joint punishment, judicial auction, and other links, and improve the level of smart execution. Improve data aggregation, management, analysis, and service capabilities, and fully leverage the important role of judicial big data in the governance and protection of the Yellow River.

17. Deepen public participation. Adhere to the combination of professional adjudication and public participation, establish expert databases and expert advisory committees, and fully leverage the role of expert assistants, expert jurors, and technical investigation officers in matters such as assessment, identification, determination of restoration plans, and ascertainment of professional facts. Broaden the channels for public participation in judicial proceedings, smooth litigation channels, and protect the personal and property rights of the people and the public interests of the ecological environment in accordance with the law. Fully implement various work mechanisms such as the disclosure of trial process information, live broadcast of court hearings, online publication of judgment documents, and disclosure of execution information, and further expand the breadth and depth of judicial transparency. Regularly publish white papers on judicial protection of the Yellow River Basin and typical cases to enhance public understanding of the judicial protection status of the Yellow River Basin. Build an all-media, three-dimensional publicity mechanism that meets the requirements of the big data era, expand publicity carriers, enhance publicity effectiveness, and create a good public opinion atmosphere for judicial services and guarantees for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.

18. Strengthen the construction of the adjudicative team. Adhere to placing the Party's political construction first, continuously improve political stance and political capability, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." Increase efforts to cultivate judicial talents in fields such as intellectual property, foreign-related affairs, environmental resources, the internet, finance, and bankruptcy, strengthen professional training, and improve adjudicative capabilities and levels. Deeply promote the construction of work style and discipline, be pragmatic, honest, upright, responsible, and build a revolutionary, standardized, professional, and specialized court team, providing a strong organizational guarantee for realizing the national strategy of ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.

Supreme People's Court

June 1, 2020
